Table7.interpretation: Metric dependence is material: proposed model improves BTC MSE but worsens BTC MAE versus GARCH. No universal neural-family winner.
Table7.sensitivity: §4.6.2 ARCH-restricted experiment: best activated likelihood worsens BTC QLIKE 1.5%, improves ETH 4.1%. This is a separate experiment and not a general effect of the unrestricted proposed model.
Table7.tests: DM on QLIKE with Newey–West HAC and within-market Holm–Bonferroni; TOST margin ±2% QLIKE; Kupiec/Christoffersen VaR and Acerbi–Szekely ES tests
Table7.test_interpretation_limit: §4.4/§5.2 describe mostly non-significant differences versus strong GARCH and DL rivals. §4.3/§5.2 report a BTC advantage for CNN-LSTM. QLIKE DM markers must not be represented as separate MSE/MAE significance tests.
Table7.risk_backtest_summary: §4.7: adequate reported crypto/equity tail coverage; Gold and Oil failures constrain generality. No comparative VaR/ES superiority test against all baselines.

Table6.reported_standardization_uncertainty: The body and Table 6 caption alternate epsilon², |epsilon|, and variance rather than standard deviation in residual standardization; retain formula/reporting uncertainty.
